sub_agent_reviews.summary: One Scout searched llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety together, returning nine 2026-06-18 arXiv candidates; Phoenix was rejected as already published on origin/data.
Read the AutoPass arXiv abstract and HTML/PDF evidence, then prepared a long-form Chinese Markdown analysis with mechanism, experiments, tables, formula, pseudocode, and limitations.
Explained Score, Analysis, Reasoning, and Evaluation Agent boundaries, LLVM pass-pipeline editing, rollback, baseline comparisons, and reproducibility limits.
Separated proven benchmark results from claims not established for production workloads, larger codebases, different LLVM versions, or semantic equivalence beyond benchmark execution.
Used arXiv primary pages and a secondary paper review for context; did not rely on social summaries for core evidence.
Article is pure Markdown under public/articles/2026/06/22/itm_dbcee56bd56a6078/index.md and avoids external image URLs.
